scope: Computer Control Phase 9A2 provider-scoped graceful application termination
platform: macOS Cocoa/AppKit via Provider registry, NSRunningApplication graceful termination and independent process observation

safetyBoundary.cleanup: physical harness may stop only its two temporary test-owned fixture processes after evidence is collected

expectedCoverage: application.terminate reports IMPLEMENTED before this physical session
terminating an already-stopped Provider is idempotent and does not launch it
application.launch starts the normal deterministic fixture
application.terminate requests graceful termination for the exact Provider bundle identity
APPLICATION_TERMINATED is returned only after the process is independently observed absent
application.list reports running=false and active=false after termination
a second AppKit fixture deliberately refuses graceful termination
the refusing process remains running after the failed operation, proving no force-kill escalation
product source contains no forceTerminate, pkill, kill, Cmd+Q or osascript fallback for application.terminate
